capability_summary.S1: Deterministic bottom-up point reconciliation with append-only persistence and thin HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters; MCP not deployed.
capability_summary.S2: Retrospective/date-bound same-lead conformal PI80/90 and upper planning bounds; no quantile or prospective guarantee.
capability_summary.S3: Frozen 14-feature Ridge model-space attribution with sealed-string reconstruction, clipping and serialization accounting; non-causal.
capability_summary.S4: Offline actual matching/maturity/completeness and locked prefix/lead monitoring; descriptive trends, no production thresholds.
capability_summary.S5: Explicit asymmetric loss/cost authority; same-cost common-prefix comparison using synthetic cost weights.
capability_summary.S6: Saved-forecast explicit capacity/workforce/buffer backlog evaluator; synthetic conditional ranking, not optimization.

isolation.s1_adapter_exception: Reviewed S1 additive hierarchy CLI bridge/MCP append; not a V0.14 prospective model/scheduler/registry/issuance change.

known_limitations: All frozen S2 H7/H15 PI/upper observations are UNDER_NOMINAL, not successful prospective calibration.
Point is not proven P50; intervals/planning bounds are not true conditional quantiles.
Historical date-bound evidence does not prove exact available_at or strict PIT.
S4 metrics are retrospective only; saved-origin coverage is not production issuance SLA.
Historical latency/freshness cannot be computed without runtime timestamp/schedule authority.
S5 costs are synthetic; real company economics and ROI are unvalidated.
S6 ranks explicit synthetic scenarios conditionally; no optimum or recommended action is established.
Region/Company interval calibration and actual quality scoring are not established.
No current-season actual access, production promotion, optimization or automatic execution.
